title: Vape Spot Apple E-Liquid 10ml
description: VapeSpot Apple delivers a crisp and refreshing fruit profile that captures the timeless taste of the orchard. The inhale provides the sharp, juicy taste of fresh Green Apple, offering a clean and vibrant flavour foundation. This is followed by a slightly sweet exhale, resulting in a beautifully balanced and highly satisfying vape that is perfect for all-day use. Formulated with a balanced 50% VG / 50% PG ratio, this freebase e-liquid provides excellent versatility. It performs flawlessly in both Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) and Restricted Direct-to-Lung (RDL) devices, pairing perfectly with coils ranging from 0.6ohm to 1.8ohm. The freebase nicotine formulation ensures a more noticeable, traditional throat hit compared to nic salts, providing a reliable and familiar sensation. Manufactured in the UK, VapeSpot e-liquids are crafted to provide premium quality and authentic taste in a budget-friendly format. Available in 6mg and 12mg strengths, this collection offers a straightforward, accessible, and consistently flavoursome vaping experience.
